text.p: The Queensland state government plans to raise A$850 million from a restructuring of the state's electricity industry, budget papers for the 1997/98 (July-June) year released on Tuesday showed.
The restructure, to take effect on July 1, would see the electricity industry operate on a more commercial basis.

As part of that, the industry's debt to asset ratio would be increased to around 35 percent from the current level of around 26 percent, to be more in line with current commercial practice, the Queensland government said.
For commercial operators, the Gray said the debt to assets ratio was between 35 and 50 percent.
"It is anticipated that this restructure will provide a one-off receipt of A$850 million to the Consolidiated Fund," the budget papers said.
Those funds would be applied to capital projects during 1997/98, the budget papers said.
